# Team Notes MVP implementation plan

## Approach

The target repository's package.json, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, next.config.ts and .gitignore stay unchanged. That decides several things:

- No dependency can be added. Persistence, password hashing, PDF output and ZIP output use only Node built-ins (node:crypto, node:fs, node:path, node:os), plus React and Next as already installed. CRC-32 for the ZIP is computed by hand.
- There is no SQL driver. src/server/db/schema.sql is the canonical relational schema, and the store in src/server/app.ts holds one table per schema table with the same columns. It runs in memory for most tests and in a JSON-file-backed form for the running application and the reload tests.
- Route handlers and middleware are outside the approved scope. The browser reaches the server through two server actions defined inline in src/app/page.tsx: `rpc(request)` for every operation and `upload(formData)` for attachment uploads. Both delegate to `dispatch` and `uploadAttachment` in src/server/app.ts. Every result is an `RpcResult` carrying an HTTP-equivalent status (200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 415, 500).
- The unchanged next.config.ts keeps the default 1 MB server-action request body limit. That bounds the attachment size limit and makes import send files in batches.
- Nothing may write to the checkout during the build. src/app/page.tsx exports `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and reads cookies, so the build never prerenders it. src/server/app.ts touches the file system only lazily, on the first dispatch, and its default data location is outside the repository (`TEAM_NOTES_DATA_DIR`, defaulting to a team-notes directory under os.tmpdir()).
- Server domain modules (auth, notes, folders, tags, search, checklists, attachments, versions, trash, export, import, activity) are plain TypeScript functions. Each takes `(db, userId, ..., now)`, never imports next/*, and returns null for a record the user does not own. That makes them testable with node:test and node:assert/strict against `createMemoryDb()`.
- Client files ending in .ts cannot contain JSX. They export React function components written with `createElement` (imported as `h`) and hooks. Only src/client/dashboard.tsx and the src/app files use JSX. Client code imports only from src/shared/types.ts, other src/client files, and src/server/checklists.ts. checklists.ts is a pure module that imports nothing except src/shared/types.ts.
- The existing tsconfig include covers the test directory, so test files are written to typecheck and to follow the existing lint configuration, just like application code. Type-only re-exports use `export type`.
- Note bodies are stored as Markdown text. The editor is a Markdown source editor with a formatting toolbar and a rendered preview. Checklist items are task-list lines in the body, so their state persists with the body and appears in exports.
- An ARIA role is used only together with the keyboard behavior that role requires. Otherwise native buttons, links and form elements are used.

## Decisions on open questions

- OD-002: auto-save runs 800 ms after the last keystroke (`AUTOSAVE_DELAY_MS` in src/shared/types.ts). Blur and visibilitychange also flush a pending save immediately.
- OD-003: trash retention is 30 days. The operator configures it through the `TEAM_NOTES_TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS` environment variable, which src/server/app.ts reads. Expired notes are purged at the start of every dispatch.
- OD-004: the maximum attachment size is 900 KB (921,600 bytes). That keeps the multipart upload under the unchanged 1 MB server-action body limit.
- OD-005: the supported attachment types are PNG, JPEG, PDF, plain text (.txt), Markdown (.md) and CSV (.csv). PNG and JPEG are also checked by magic bytes.
- OD-006: a save that changes the title or body, compared with the note's newest version, creates a version holding the saved title and body when the note has no version yet or its newest version is at least 2 minutes old (`VERSION_MIN_INTERVAL_MS`). A version restore always creates exactly one version, whatever the interval or content.
- OD-007: version retention is a period of 90 days (`VERSION_RETENTION_DAYS`). Versions created more than 90 days ago are removed at the start of every dispatch, and every newer version is kept.
- OD-008: no email service is in scope. A reset request creates a single-use token generated from 32 bytes of crypto.randomBytes, encoded as base64url and stored only as a SHA-256 hash, expiring after 30 minutes. `deliverResetLink` in src/server/auth.ts is the delivery seam: it writes the link `/?reset=<token>` to the server console as a stub channel until an email service is chosen. Opening that link shows the set-new-password form with the token filled in. Completing the reset revokes every session of that user. The request response is identical whether or not the email has an account.
- OD-009: search is a linear case-insensitive scan over the user's notes, using cached lowercased text. The target is under one second for 10,000 notes, and it is not a gated criterion.
- OD-010: there is no enforced threshold. Saves are debounced and non-blocking.
- OD-011: title matches rank before body-only matches, and ties go to the newest last-updated time.
- OD-012: opening a result whose match is in the body selects the first match in the editor textarea and scrolls it into view. This does not apply when the match is in the title only.
- OD-013: Alt+N (Option+N on macOS, matched by event.code KeyN) creates a new note. Arrow Up and Arrow Down move focus between the note buttons of a list or the search results, and Enter opens the focused note. After a save, focus stays where it was. After a dialog closes, focus returns to the control that opened it.
- OD-014: when a folder is deleted, its subfolders move up to the deleted folder's parent and keep their notes. Only the deleted folder's own notes follow the user's choice between moving them to another folder and leaving them uncategorized.
- OD-015: an import creates one note per .md or .txt file, and the note body is the file's exact content. The title comes from the first level-one heading line, or else the file name without its extension. Folders come from the distinct directory segments of the file's relative path (webkitRelativePath) that do not already exist. Tags come from a leading front-matter tags line, counting only those not already present ignoring case. The attachment count is always 0, because text imports carry no binary files.
- OD-016: text and focus indicators meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast: 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for focus outlines and large text.
- OD-017: the target is the current and previous major versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop, plus Safari on iOS and Chrome on Android. This needs no code beyond the standard APIs used.
- OD-018: hosting, HTTPS termination and backups are not part of this delivery. The only operator hooks are the data directory and the retention environment variables.
- OD-019: the product name is Team Notes.
- OD-020: a search snippet highlights the matched term with a mark element whenever the snippet contains it.
- OD-021: pinned notes float above unpinned notes only under the pinned-status sort. The dashboard still has its own pinned-notes section.
- OD-022: the full-collection export is a ZIP. It holds one Markdown file per note under notes/ (folder path as directories, with front matter for tags, pinned, archived, created and updated) and the attachment files under attachments/<note id>/.
- OD-023: these actions show a confirmation: permanent note deletion (Delete permanently), folder deletion (Delete folder), tag deletion (Delete tag), attachment deletion (Delete attachment), and full-collection export (Export all notes).
- OD-024: below 768 px, opening a note shows the editor full width with a Back to notes button, and the note list is hidden until that button is used.

## Tasks

- In src/shared/types.ts, add the following:
  - record types mirroring schema.sql: UserRecord, SessionRecord, PasswordResetRecord, PreferencesRecord, FolderRecord with parentId and position, NoteRecord, TagRecord with color, NoteTagRecord, AttachmentRecord, VersionRecord, ActivityRecord. NoteRecord has title, body, folderId, pinned, archived, trashedAt, trashedFromFolderId, createdAt, updatedAt, archivedAt and restoredAt.
  - the Db interface: one array-backed table per record type, plus a BlobStore with get, put and delete for attachment bytes.
  - the view types: NoteSummary (title, preview, tags, folder name, pinned flag, checklist progress, timestamps), NoteDetail, FolderNode, SearchHit (snippet, match offsets and pinned flag), ImportFile, ImportReview (note count, new folder paths, new tag names, attachment count), VersionEntry, AttachmentInfo, TrashEntry (with its purge time).
  - NoteListQuery, with sort last-updated, created, title or pinned, and filters for folderId, tagId, pinned, archived, openTasks and a date range.
  - the RpcRequest discriminated union naming every operation, and RpcResult with the status codes listed in the approach.
  - the DestructiveActionLabel union of exactly Delete permanently, Delete folder, Delete tag, Delete attachment and Export all notes.
  - the constants AUTOSAVE_DELAY_MS, MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES, SUPPORTED_ATTACHMENT_TYPES, VERSION_MIN_INTERVAL_MS, VERSION_RETENTION_DAYS, DEFAULT_TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS and NEW_NOTE_SHORTCUT_LABEL.
  - displayTitle(title), which returns Untitled note when the trimmed title is empty.
- In src/server/db/schema.sql, write SQLite DDL with primary keys, foreign keys and indexes for these tables: users, sessions, password_resets, preferences, folders, notes, tags, note_tags, attachments, versions and activity.
  - Add a case-insensitive unique index on tags (user_id, name COLLATE NOCASE).
  - Add a header comment stating that the application store in src/server/app.ts mirrors these tables column for column, and that checklist items live in the note body.
- In src/server/activity.ts, implement recordActivity(db, userId, noteId, kind, at) and listActivity(db, userId, noteId).
  - The kinds are created, updated, archived, unarchived, trashed, restored, version_restored and deleted.
  - Activity rows outlive permanent note deletion, so that the deletion timestamp stays recorded.
- In src/server/auth.ts, implement register(db, email, password, now).
  - The email is trimmed and lowercased. An empty password is rejected with status 400.
  - An existing email is rejected with status 409 and the message An account with this email already exists, and no second account is created.
  - The password is stored only as a scrypt hash with a 16-byte random salt, in the format salt:hash in hex.
- In src/server/auth.ts, implement sign-in and sessions:
  - signIn verifies the password with crypto.timingSafeEqual. It returns the message Email or password is incorrect without creating a session on failure.
  - A session token is 32 random bytes in base64url, and only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Sessions expire after 30 days.
  - signOut deletes the session row. resolveSession returns the user only for a stored, unexpired session.
- In src/server/auth.ts, implement requestPasswordReset with the deliverResetLink stub described under OD-008, and completePasswordReset. requestPasswordReset generates the reset token with crypto.randomBytes(32) encoded as base64url, never derived from a timestamp, email address or counter, and stores only its SHA-256 hash. completePasswordReset rejects expired or used tokens, replaces the password hash, marks the token used, and deletes every session of that user.
- In src/server/auth.ts, implement getPreferences and updatePreferences. Both act only on the session user's own row and take no owner id. Preferences hold the note-list sort, the collapsed folder ids and the dashboard view.

  - checklistProgress(body) returns complete and total.
  - hasOpenTasks(body) and formatProgress(progress), which renders N of M complete.
  - setItemDone(body, index, done) rewrites only that item's bracket, and insertChecklistItem(body, cursor, text) inserts a task-list line.
- In src/server/notes.ts, implement note storage:
  - createNote stamps createdAt and updatedAt and records created activity.
  - getNote returns NoteDetail with tags, folder, attachments and checklist progress.

  - listVersions returns the note's versions inside the retention period, newest first.
  - restoreVersion sets the note's title and body to the version's, stamps updatedAt and restoredAt, and records version_restored activity. It calls recordVersion with force exactly once and does not let updateNote add a second version, so it creates exactly one new version and deletes none.

  - Bytes go into the BlobStore. The record stores name, type, size and uploadedAt.
- In src/server/attachments.ts, implement listAttachments, getAttachmentContent (returns the exact stored bytes only to the owner of the note, null otherwise) and deleteAttachment.
- In src/server/export.ts, implement single-note exports:
  - exportNoteMarkdown: a level-one heading with the title, a blank line, then the body.

- In src/server/app.ts, implement currentUser(db, token, now), dispatch(db, token, request, now) and uploadAttachment(db, token, formData, now):
